hero.title: Growing since 2015
hero.description: LTS Logistik was founded in Berlin in January 2015 and has grown from a courier service into one of Germany's modern transport companies.

story: We started in the courier, express and parcel business with a handful of vehicles and a clear principle: deliver on time, communicate honestly, get better every day.

Today we dispatch more than 260 of our own vehicles and employ over 200 people at ten locations. Europe-wide transport of chilled fresh goods is one of our core competences, alongside national and international routes, express and special transport.
We remain what we were on day one: an owner-managed company with short paths, where decisions are made quickly and commitments are kept.
